{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Nsxu7tzXv8kWqKabLF75YP","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t// cedar_bench — per-opcode microbenchmark + output dump for the SIMD\n2\t// autoresearch loop (docs/prd-simd-autoresearch.md §5.3).\n3\t//\n4\t//   cedar_bench --list\n5\t//   cedar_bench --opcode op_mul [--reps 500] [--warmup 200] [--json]\n6\t//   cedar_bench --opcode op_mul --dump out.f32 [--blocks 1024]\n7\t//   add --scalar to force the scalar fallback on a CEDAR_SIMD build\n8\t//   add --seed N for randomised hidden stimuli (full verify only)\n9\t//\n10\t// Timing: one program of INSTANCES copies of the opcode (distinct state ids,\n11\t// shared stimulus inputs) is run through VM::process_block; ns/block is the\n12\t// per-copy cost, with an interleaved empty-program VM's time subtracted. Stimuli rotate\n13\t// through STIM_BLOCKS precomputed blocks so the opcode never sees a constant.\n14\t//\n15\t// Dump: a fresh single-copy VM is run for --blocks blocks; the opcode's two\n16\t// output buffers (out, out+1) are written as raw float32, L block then R\n17\t// block. This is the A/B oracle for the equality gate — the stimuli are the\n18\t// same ones the timing path uses (one source of truth).\n19\t\n20\t#include \"cedar/vm/vm.hpp\"\n21\t#include \"cedar/vm/instruction.hpp\"\n22\t#include \"cedar/dsp/simd.hpp\"\n23\t\n24\t#include <algorithm>\n25\t#include <array>\n26\t#include <chrono>\n27\t#include <cmath>\n28\t#include <cstdint>\n29\t#include <cstdio>\n30\t#include <cstring>\n31\t#include <fstream>\n32\t#include <functional>\n33\t#include <memory>\n34\t#include <random>\n35\t#include <string>\n36\t#include <string_view>\n37\t#include <vector>\n38\t\n39\tusing namespace cedar;\n40\t\n41\tnamespace {\n42\t\n43\tconstexpr std::size_t INSTANCES = 64;\n44\tconstexpr std::size_t STIM_BLOCKS = 256;\n45\tconstexpr std::uint16_t IN_BASE = 0;    // stimulus buffers 0..4\n46\tconstexpr std::uint16_t OUT_BASE = 8;   // outputs at 8 + 2k (stereo pairs)\n47\tconstexpr float SR = 48000.0f;\n48\tconstexpr std::uint16_t NONE = 0xFFFF;\n49\t\n50\t// Stimulus for one input slot at absolute sample index n (0..STIM_BLOCKS*BLOCK_SIZE).\n51\tusing Stim = std::function<float(std::size_t n)>;\n52\t\n53\t// --seed N (N != 0) switches every stimulus to a randomised \"hidden\" variant\n54\t// (PRD §6 / research P5): the full verify picks a fresh seed per call and\n55\t// dumps baseline and candidate with it, so a kernel cannot be tuned to the\n56\t// fixed stimuli the quick check and the timing path use.\n57\tstd::uint32_t g_seed = 0;\n58\tstd::mt19937 g_hidden_rng;  // draws per-stimulus variations in hidden mode\n59\t\n60\tfloat frac(std::size_t n, std::size_t period) {\n61\t    return static_cast<float>(n % period) / static_cast<float>(period);\n62\t}\n63\t\n64\t// Audio-rate signal input: seeded noise → log sine sweep → impulse train →\n65\t// ramp, a quarter of the stimulus window each (PRD §4.3 fixed stimuli).\n66\tstruct AudioStim {\n67\t    float gain;\n68\t    std::vector<float> noise;\n69\t    explicit AudioStim(float g) : gain(g), noise(STIM_BLOCKS * BLOCK_SIZE) {\n70\t        std::mt19937 rng(g_seed ? g_seed : 0xCEDA5u);\n71\t        std::uniform_real_distribution<float> d(-1.0f, 1.0f);\n72\t        for (auto& x : noise) x = d(rng);\n73\t        if (g_seed) make_hidden(rng);\n74\t    }\n75\t    // Hidden mode: 8 segments, each a random choice of noise at a random\n76\t    // gain (from near-denormal to 4x the nominal level), sparse random\n77\t    // impulses, DC steps, or silence. Stimuli rotate\n// through STIM_BLOCKS precomputed blocks so the opcode never sees a constant.\n//\n// Dump: a fresh single-copy VM is run for --blocks blocks; the opcode's two\n// output buffers (out, out+1) are written as raw float32, L block then R\n// block. This is the A/B oracle for the equality gate — the stimuli are the\n// same ones the timing path uses (one source of truth).\n\n#include \"cedar/vm/vm.hpp\"\n#include \"cedar/vm/instruction.hpp\"\n#include \"cedar/dsp/simd.hpp\"\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <array>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <fstream>\n#include <functional>\n#include <memory>\n#include <random>\n#include <string>\n#include <string_view>\n#include <vector>\n\nusing namespace cedar;\n\nnamespace {\n\nconstexpr std::size_t INSTANCES = 64;\nconstexpr std::size_t STIM_BLOCKS = 256;\nconstexpr std::uint16_t IN_BASE = 0;    // stimulus buffers 0..4\nconstexpr std::uint16_t OUT_BASE = 8;   // outputs at 8 + 2k (stereo pairs)\nconstexpr float SR = 48000.0f;\nconstexpr std::uint16_t NONE = 0xFFFF;\n\n// Stimulus for one input slot at absolute sample index n (0..STIM_BLOCKS*BLOCK_SIZE).\nusing Stim = std::function<float(std::size_t n)>;\n\n// --seed N (N != 0) switches every stimulus to a randomised \"hidden\" variant\n// (PRD §6 / research P5): the full verify picks a fresh seed per call and\n// dumps baseline and candidate with it, so a kernel cannot be tuned to the\n// fixed stimuli the quick check and the timing path use.\nstd::uint32_t g_seed = 0;\nstd::mt19937 g_hidden_rng;  // draws per-stimulus variations in hidden mode\n\nfloat frac(std::size_t n, std::size_t period) {\n    return static_cast<float>(n % period) / static_cast<float>(period);\n}\n\n// Audio-rate signal input: seeded noise → log sine sweep → impulse train →\n// ramp, a quarter of the stimulus window each (PRD §4.3 fixed stimuli).\nstruct AudioStim {\n    float gain;\n    std::vector<float> noise;\n    explicit AudioStim(float g) : gain(g), noise(STIM_BLOCKS * BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        std::mt19937 rng(g_seed ? g_seed : 0xCEDA5u);\n        std::uniform_real_distribution<float> d(-1.0f, 1.0f);\n        for (auto& x : noise) x = d(rng);\n        if (g_seed) make_hidden(rng);\n    }\n    // Hidden mode: 8 segments, each a random choice of noise at a random\n    // gain (from near-denormal to 4x the nominal level), sparse random\n    // impulses, DC steps, or silence. Every seed is guaranteed one\n    // near-denormal noise segment (1e-35..1e-25) and one hot one (2-4x),\n    // at random positions, so that coverage never depends on luck.\n    void make_hidden(std::mt19937& rng) {\n        std::uniform_real_distribution<float> u(0.0f, 1.0f);\n        constexpr std::size_t seg = STIM_BLOCKS * BLOCK_SIZE / 8;\n        const auto tiny_seg = static_cast<std::size_t>(u(rng) * 8.0f) % 8;\n        const auto hot_seg = (tiny_seg + 1 + static_cast<std::size_t>(u(rng) * 7.0f) % 7) % 8;\n        for (std::size_t s = 0; s < 8; ++s) {\n            int kind = static_cast<int>(u(rng) * 4.0f);\n            float level = gain * std::pow(10.0f, -30.0f * u(rng) * u(rng)) * (1.0f + 3.0f * u(rng));\n            if (s == tiny_seg) { kind = 0; level = gain * std::pow(10.0f, -25.0f - 10.0f * u(rng)); }\n            if (s == hot_seg) { kind = 0; level = gain * (2.0f + 2.0f * u(rng)); }\n            float dc = level * (2.0f * u(rng) - 1.0f);\n            for (std::size_t k = s * seg; k < (s + 1) * seg; ++k) {\n                switch (kind) {\n                    case 0: noise[k] *= level; break;\n                    case 1: noise[k] = u(rng) < 0.002f ? level * (u(rng) < 0.5f ? -1.0f : 1.0f) : 0.0f; break;\n                    case 2: noise[k] = (k % 4096 == 0) ? (dc = level * (2.0f * u(rng) - 1.0f)) : dc; break;\n                    default: noise[k] = 0.0f; break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    float operator()(std::size_t n) const {\n        if (g_seed) return noise[n];\n        constexpr std::size_t total = STIM_BLOCKS * BLOCK_SIZE;\n        constexpr std::size_t quarter = total / 4;\n        std::size_t seg = n / quarter, k = n % quarter;\n        float t = static_cast<float>(k) / static_cast<float>(quarter);\n        switch (seg) {\n            case 0: return gain * noise[n];\n            case 1: {\n                // 20 Hz → 20 kHz exponential sweep, phase-integrated\n                double f0 = 20.0, f1 = 20000.0, T = double(quarter) / double(SR);\n                double tt = double(k) / double(SR);\n                double kk = std::log(f1 / f0) / T;\n                double ph = 2.0 * 3.14159265358979 * f0 * (std::exp(kk * tt) - 1.0) / kk;\n                return gain * static_cast<float>(std::sin(ph));\n            }\n            case 2: return (k % 997 == 0) ? gain : 0.0f;\n            default: return gain * (2.0f * t - 1.0f);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\nStim ramp(float lo, float hi, std::size_t period) {\n    if (g_seed) {  // hidden: same range, random rate and phase\n        std::uniform_real_distribution<float> u(0.0f, 1.0f);\n        auto p = static_cast<std::size_t>(static_cast<float>(period) * (0.05f + 3.0f * u(g_hidden_rng))) + 1;\n        auto off = static_cast<std::size_t>(u(g_hidden_rng) * static_cast<float>(p));\n        return [=](std::size_t n) { return lo + (hi - lo) * frac(n + off, p); };\n    }\n    return [=](std::size_t n) { return lo + (hi - lo) * frac(n, period); };\n}\nStim constant(float v) { return [=](std::size_t) { return v; }; }\n\nstruct Case {\n    const char* name;\n    Opcode op;\n    std::vector<Stim> inputs;      // wired to inputs[0..]; remaining slots NONE\n    std::uint16_t first_unused = 0; // inputs >= this index are NONE\n};\n\nstd::vector<Case> make_cases() {\n    AudioStim audio(1.0f), hot(3.0f);\n    constexpr std::size_t P = 48000;  // param sweep period (~1 s)\n    std::vector<Case> c;\n    c.push_back({\"op_add\", Opcode::ADD, {audio, ramp(-1, 1, 777)}});\n    c.push_back({\"op_sub\", Opcode::SUB, {audio, ramp(-1, 1, 777)}});\n    c.push_back({\"op_mul\", Opcode::MUL, {audio, ramp(-1, 1, 777)}});\n    c.push_back({\"op_distort_tanh\", Opcode::DISTORT_TANH, {hot, ramp(0.5f, 8.0f, P)}});\n    c.push_back({\"op_distort_soft\", Opcode::DISTORT_SOFT, {hot, ramp(0.1f, 2.0f, P)}});\n    c.push_back({\"op_filter_formant\", Opcode::FILTER_FORMANT,\n                 {audio, ramp(0, 4, P), constant(2.0f), ramp(0, 1, P / 3), ramp(1, 20, P / 2)}});\n    for (auto [name, op] : {std::pair{\"op_filter_svf_lp\", Opcode::FILTER_SVF_LP},\n                            std::pair{\"op_filter_svf_hp\", Opcode::FILTER_SVF_HP},\n                            std::pair{\"op_filter_svf_bp\", Opcode::FILTER_SVF_BP}}) {\n        c.push_back({name, op, {audio, ramp(40, 12000, P), ramp(0.5f, 8.0f, P / 2)}});\n    }\n    // C5 survey candidates (PRD OQ5) — ranked by bench.py --pin; saturation function (fast tanh approximation)\n// Provides analog-like nonlinearity in the feedback path\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline float soft_clip(float x) {\n    // Pade approximant of tanh, != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* freq = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n state = ctx.states->get_or_create<MoogState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    // ExtendedParams<2>: ext[0] = dry (default 0.0), ext[1] = wet (default 1.0)\n    const auto* ext = ctx.states->get_if<ExtendedParams<2>>(ext_params_state_id(inst.state_id));\n    const float* dry_buf = nullptr; float dry_const = 0.0f;\n    const float* wet_buf = nullptr; float wet_const = 1.0f;\n    if (w.is_constant()) wet_const = w.constant; else wet_buf = ctx.buffers->get(w.buffer_idx);\n    }\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float cutoff = freq[i];\n (std::abs(x) > 4.0f) return 0.5f * (std::exp(std::abs(x)));\n\n    float x2 = x * x;\n    return 1.0f + x2 * (0.5f + x2 * 0.0416667f);\n}\n\n// Default constants for diode ladder filter (used when the characteristic \"squelchy\" acid sound.\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_filter_diode(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n fb_gain_in = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[4]);\n    auto& state = ctx.states->get_or_create<DiodeState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    // ExtendedParams<2>: ext[0] = dry (default 0.0), ext[1] = wet (default auto& w = ext->params[1];\n        if (w.is_constant()) wet_const = w.constant; else wet_buf = ctx.buffers->get(w.buffer_idx);\n    }\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n drywet::coeff(wet_buf, i, wet_const);\n\n        // Update coefficients if parameters changed (shared across channels)\n        if (cutoff != state.last_freq || resonance != state.last_res) {\n            state.last_freq = cutoff;\n            state.last_res = resonance;\n\n            // Frequency warping - clamp to safe range\n            float f = std::clamp(cutoff / ctx.sample_rate, 0.0f, 0.45f);\n\n            // g coefficient using tan for frequency warping\n            state.g = std::tan(PI * f);\n\n            // Resonance: diode ladder has different feedback topology\n            state.k = std::clamp(resonance, 0.0f, 4.0f);\n        }\n\n        // G for trapezoidal integration (shared)\n        float G = state.g / (1.0f + state.g);\n\n        for (std::size_t ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {\n            float xin = (ch == 0) ? input[i] : (stereo_in ? input_r[i] : input[i]);\n\n            // Diode ladder feedback (per-channel cap state)\n            float fb_voltage = state.cap[ch][3] * vt_inv;\n            float feedback = state.k * diode_sinh(fb_voltage) * vt * fb_gain;\n\n            // Input with feedback\n            float x = xin - feedback;\n\n            // float* in_r,\n                                       const float* freq, const float* q,\n                                       const float* dry_level, const float* wet_level,\n saturation function (fast tanh approximation)\n// Provides analog-like nonlinearity in the feedback path\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline float soft_clip(float x) {\n    // Pade approximant of tanh, ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* freq = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* res = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[2]);\n    const float* mode_in = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[3]);\n    const float* clip_threshold_in = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[4]);\n    auto& state = ctx.states->get_or_create<SallenkeyState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    // ExtendedParams<2>: ext[0] = dry (default 0.0), ext[1] = wet (default 1.0)\n    const auto* ext = ctx.states->get_if<ExtendedParams<2>>(ext_params_state_id(inst.state_id));\n    const float* dry_buf = nullptr; float dry_const = 0.0f;\n    const float* wet_buf = nullptr; float wet_const = 1.0f;\n    if (ext) {\n        const auto& d = ext->params[0];\n        if (d.is_constant()) dry_const = d.constant; else dry_buf = ctx.buffers->get(d.buffer_idx);\n        const auto& w = ext->params[1];\n        if (w.is_constant()) wet_const = w.constant; else wet_buf = ctx.buffers->get(w.buffer_idx);\n    }\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float cutoff = freq[i];\n        float resonance = res[i];\n        float mode = mode_in[i];\n\n        // Runtime tunable parameter (use default if zero/negative)\n        float clip_threshold = clip_threshold_in[i] > 0.0f ? clip_threshold_in[i] : SALLENKEY_CLIP_THRESHOLD_DEFAULT;\n        float dry = drywet::coeff(dry_buf, i, dry_const);\n        float wet = drywet::coeff(wet_buf, i, wet_const);\n\n        // Update coefficients if needed (shared across channels)\n        if (cutoff != state.last_freq || resonance != state.last_res) {\n            state.last_freq = cutoff;\n            state.last_res = resonance;\n\n            // Frequency warping\n            float f = std::clamp(cutoff / ctx.sample_rate, 0.0f, 0.45f);\n            state.g = std::tan(PI * f);\n\n            // Resonance - MS-20 has very aggressive feedback\n            state.k = std::clamp(resonance, 0.0f, 4.0f);\n        }\n\n        // G for trapezoidal integration (shared)\n        float G = state.g / (1.0f + state.g);\n        float m = std::clamp(mode, 0.0f, 1.0f);\n\n        for (std::size_t ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {\n            float xin = (ch == 0) ? input[i] : (stereo_in ? input_r[i] : input[i]);\n\n            // Get feedback with diode clipping (the MS-20 \"scream\") — per-channel state\n            float fb = state.cap2[ch] * state.k;\n            fb = diode_clip(fb, state.diode_state[ch], clip_threshold);\n\n            // Input with feedback\n            float x = xin - fb;\n\n            // First stage\n            float v1 = G * (x - state.cap1[ch]) + state.cap1[ch];\n\n            // Second stage with resonance boost\n            float v2 = G * (v1 - state.cap2[ch]) + state.cap2[ch];\n\n            // Update capacitor states\n            state.cap1[ch] = clamp_audio(2.0f * v1 - state.cap1[ch]);\n            state.cap2[ch] = clamp_audio(2.0f * v2 - state.cap2[ch]);\n\n            // Mode selection: 0 = lowpass, 1 = highpass\n            float lp = v2;\n            float hp = x - v1 * (1.0f + state.k * 0.5f) - v2;\n\n            // Crossfade between LP and HP based on mode\n            float processed = lp * (1.0f - m) + hp * m;\n            (ch == 0 ? out_l : out_r)[i] = drywet::mix(xin, processed, dry, wet);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n}  // namespace cedar\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":159,"oldLines":7,"newStart":159,"newLines":7,"lines":["     const __m256 one = _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f);","     const __m256 qmin = _mm256_set1_ps(0.1f);","     const __m256 pi = _mm256_set1_ps(PI);","-    const __m256 sr = _mm256_set1_ps(sample_rate);","+    const __m256d inv_sr = _mm256_set1_pd(1.0 / static_cast<double>(sample_rate));","     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {","         const __m256 f = _mm256_load_ps(freq + i);","         const __m256 f0 = _mm256_and_ps(_mm256_cmp_ps(zero, f, _CMP_LT_OQ), f);  // max(0, f)"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true}}

float* in_r,\n                                       const float* freq, const float* q,\n                                       const float* dry_level, const float* wet_level,\n alignas(32) float Y[2 * BLOCK_SIZE];\n\n    const __m256 hi = _mm256_set1_ps(sample_rate * 0.49f);\n    const __m256 lo = _mm256_set1_ps(20.0f);\n    const __m256 zero = _mm256_setzero_ps();\n ============================================================================\n// Moog-Style Ladder Filter\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Soft saturation function (fast tanh approximation)\n// Provides analog-like nonlinearity in the feedback path\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline float soft_clip(float x) {\n    // Pade approximant of tanh, ladder filter\nconstexpr float MOOG_MAX_RESONANCE_DEFAULT = 4.0f;\nconstexpr float MOOG_INPUT_SCALE_DEFAULT = 0.5f;\n\n// FILTER_MOOG: 4-pole (24dB/oct) Moog-style ladder filter\n// in0: input saturation function (fast tanh approximation)\n// Provides analog-like nonlinearity in the feedback path\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline float soft_clip(float x) {\n    // Pade approximant of tanh, signal\n// in1: cutoff frequency (Hz)\n// in2: resonance (0.0-max_resonance, self-oscillates at ~4.0)\n// in3: max_resonance - self-oscillation threshold (default 4.0)\n// in4: input_scale - preamp character\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_filter_moog(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out_l = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    float* out_r = != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* freq = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n state = ctx.states->get_or_create<MoogState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    // ExtendedParams<2>: ext[0] = dry (default 0.0), ext[1] = wet (default 1.0)\n    const auto* ext = ctx.states->get_if<ExtendedParams<2>>(ext_params_state_id(inst.state_id));\n    const float* dry_buf = nullptr; float dry_const = 0.0f;\n    const float* wet_buf = nullptr; float wet_const = 1.0f;\n    if (w.is_constant()) wet_const = w.constant; else wet_buf = ctx.buffers->get(w.buffer_idx);\n    }\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        float cutoff = freq[i];\n        float resonance = res[i];\n\n        // Runtime tunable parameters (use defaults if zero/negative)\n        float max_resonance = max_res_in[i] > 0.0f ? max_res_in[i] : MOOG_MAX_RESONANCE_DEFAULT;\n stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n fb_gain_in = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[4]);\n    auto& state = ctx.states->get_or_create<DiodeState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    // ExtendedParams<2>: ext[0] = dry (default 0.0), ext[1] = wet (default 1.0)\n    const auto* ext = ctx.states->get_if<ExtendedParams<2>>(ext_params_state_id(inst.state_id));\n    const float* dry_buf = nullptr; float dry_const = 0.0f;\n    const float* wet_buf = nullptr; auto& w = ext->params[1];\n        if (w.is_constant()) wet_const = w.constant; else wet_buf = ctx.buffers->get(w.buffer_idx);\n    }\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n drywet::coeff(wet_buf, i, wet_const);\n\n        // Update coefficients if parameters changed (shared across channels)\n        if (cutoff != state.last_freq || resonance != state.last_res) {\n            state.last_freq = cutoff;\n            state.last_res = resonance;\n\n            // Frequency warping - clamp to safe range\n            float f = std::clamp(cutoff / ctx.sample_rate, 0.0f, 0.45f);\n\n            // g coefficient using tan for frequency warping\n            state.g = std::tan(PI * f);\n\n            // Resonance: diode ladder has different feedback topology\n            state.k = std::clamp(resonance, 0.0f, 4.0f);\n        }\n\n        // G for trapezoidal integration (shared)\n        float G = state.g / (1.0f + state.g);\n\n        for (std::size_t ch = 0; ch < 2; ++ch) {\n            float xin = (ch == 0) ? input[i] : (stereo_in ? input_r[i] : input[i]);\n\n            // Diode ladder feedback (per-channel cap state)\n            float fb_voltage = state.cap[ch][3] * vt_inv;\n            float feedback = state.k * diode_sinh(fb_voltage) * vt * fb_gain;\n\n            // Input with feedback\n            float x = xin - feedback;\n\n            // sample_rate) noexcept {\n    alignas(32) float A1[BLOCK_SIZE], A2[BLOCK_SIZE], A3[BLOCK_SIZE], K[BLOCK_SIZE], G[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    alignas(32) float F0[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    alignas(32) float Y[2 * ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* vowel_a = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n    const float* vowel_b = ctx.states->get_if<ExtendedParams<2>>(ext_params_state_id(inst.state_id));\n    const float* dry_buf = nullptr; float dry_const = 0.0f;\n    const float* wet_buf = nullptr; float wet_const = 1.0f;\n _mm256_sub_ps(_mm256_div_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(W, W), _mm256_add_ps(W, iy)), r);\n        rb = _mm256_mul_ps(sgn, _mm256_sub_ps(iy, _mm256_mul_ps(c(2.0f), _mm256_sub_ps(X, rb))));\n        // big and |X| < 2^-13: sgn*iy * (1 - 2*iy*X)\n        const __m256 tiny = _mm256_cmp_ps(_mm256_andnot_ps(signmask, xb), c(0x1p-13f), _CMP_LT_OQ);\n        const __m256 rt = _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_mul_ps(sgn, iy),\n big);\n    }\n    return res;\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 inline __m128 svf_clamp_ps(__m128 v) noexcept {\n    const __m128 c = _mm_min_ps(_mm_max_ps(v, _mm_set1_ps(-10.0f)), _mm_set1_ps(10.0f));\n    return _mm_and_ps(c, _mm_cmpord_ps(v, v));  // NaN -> 0\n}\n\n// True unless every |lane| of a[0:1], b[0:1] lies in [2^-35, 10] (NaN fails).\n// In that range s + DENORMAL_DC == s exactly and clamp_audio is the identity.\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 inline bool svf_out_of_range(__m128 a, __m128 b) noexcept {\n    const __m128i ab = _mm_castps_si128(_mm_and_ps(_mm_movelh_ps(a, b),\n _mm_add_epi32(ab, _mm_set1_epi32(0x52000000));\n    const __m128i bad = _mm_cmpgt_epi32(biased, _mm_set1_epi32(static_cast<int>(0x93200000u)));\n    return _mm_movemask_ps(_mm_castsi128_ps(bad)) != 0;\n}\n\n// One exact (scalar-order) integrator step with doubled coefficients d1..d3.\n// In: sv = {s1, s2, x, d1}. Out: sv = {s1', s2', v1, v2}. Returns whether the\n// new state admits the fast path.\n[[gnu::noinline, gnu::cold]] CEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 inline bool svf_exact_step(__m128* sv, __m128 d2,\n                                                                         __m128 d3) noexcept {\n    const __m128 half = _mm_set1_ps(0.5f);\n    const __m128 dc = _mm_set1_ps(DENORMAL_DC);\n    const __m128 two = _mm_set1_ps(2.0f);\n    const __m128 s1 = sv[0], s2 = sv[1], x = sv[2];\n    const __m128 a1 = _mm_mul_ps(half, sv[3]);\n    const __m128 a2 = _mm_mul_ps(half, d2);\n    const __m128 a3 = _mm_mul_ps(half, d3);\n    const __m128 t1 = _mm_add_ps(s1, dc);\n    const __m128 t2 = _mm_add_ps(s2, dc);\n    const __m128 v3 = _mm_sub_ps(x, t2);\n    const __m128 v1 = _mm_add_ps(_mm_mul_ps(a1, t1), _mm_mul_ps(a2, v3));\n    const __m128 v2 = _mm_add_ps(_mm_add_ps(t2, _mm_mul_ps(a2, t1)), _mm_mul_ps(a3, v3));\n    sv[0] = svf_clamp_ps(_mm_sub_ps(_mm_mul_ps(two, v1), s1));\n    sv[1] = svf_clamp_ps(_mm_sub_ps(_mm_mul_ps(two, v2), s2));\n    sv[2] = v1;\n    sv[3] = v2;\n    return !svf_out_of_range(sv[0], sv[1]);\n}\n\n// Mode: 0 = lowpass (v2), 1 = highpass, 2 = bandpass (v1).\n// Coefficients are a pure function of (freq, q), so they are computed for the\n// whole block first; only the integrator recurrence stays serial.\ntemplate <int Mode>\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 inline void svf_avx2(SVFState& state, float* out_l, float* out_r,\n                                       const float* in_l, const float* in_r,\n                                       const float* freq, const float* q,\n                                       const float* dry_level, const float* wet_level,\n                                       float sample_rate) noexcept {\n    alignas(32) float A1[BLOCK_SIZE], A2[BLOCK_SIZE], A3[BLOCK_SIZE], K[BLOCK_SIZE], G[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    alignas(32) float F0[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    alignas(32) float Y[2 * BLOCK_SIZE];\n\n    const __m256 hi = _mm256_set1_ps(sample_rate * 0.49f);\n    const __m256 lo = _mm256_set1_ps(20.0f);\n    const __m256 zero = _mm256_setzero_ps();\n    const __m256 one = _mm256_set1_ps(1.0f);\n    const __m256 qmin = _mm256_set1_ps(0.1f);\n    const __m256 pi = _mm256_set1_ps(PI);\n    const __m256d inv_sr = _mm256_set1_pd(1.0 / static_cast<double>(sample_rate));\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8) {\n        const __m256 f = _mm256_load_ps(freq + i);\n        const __m256 f0 = _mm256_and_ps(_mm256_cmp_ps(zero, f, _CMP_LT_OQ), f);  // max(0, f)\n        __m256 fc = _mm256_blendv_ps(f0, hi, _mm256_cmp_ps(hi, f0, _CMP_LT_OQ));\n        fc = _mm256_blendv_ps(fc, lo, _mm256_cmp_ps(f0, lo, _CMP_LT_OQ));\n        const __m256 qv = _mm256_load_ps(q + i);\n        const __m256 qc = _mm256_blendv_ps(qmin, qv, _mm256_cmp_ps(qmin, qv, _CMP_LT_OQ));\n        // (pi*fc)/sr, correctly rounded: the double product is within ~2^-52\n        // of the true quotient, which is >= 2^-49 (relative) from any float\n        // rounding midpoint, so the final double->float rounding is exact.\n        const __m256 pf = _mm256_mul_ps(pi, fc);\n        const __m128 xlo = _mm256_cvtpd_ps(_mm256_mul_pd(_mm256_cvtps_pd(_mm256_castps256_ps128(pf)), inv_sr));\n        const __m128 xhi = _mm256_cvtpd_ps(_mm256_mul_pd(_mm256_cvtps_pd(_mm256_extractf128_ps(pf, 1)), inv_sr));\n        const __m256 x = _mm256_insertf128_ps(_mm256_castps128_ps256(xlo), xhi, 1);\n        const __m256 g = svf_tanf_ps(x);\n        const __m256 k = _mm256_div_ps(one, qc);\n        const __m256 a1 = _mm256_div_ps(one, _mm256_add_ps(one, _mm256_mul_ps(g, _mm256_add_ps(g, k))));\n        const __m256 a2 = _mm256_mul_ps(g, a1);\n        const __m256 a3 = _mm256_mul_ps(g, a2);\n        _mm256_store_ps(F0 + i, f0);\n        _mm256_store_ps(G + i, g);\n        _mm256_store_ps(K + i, k);\n        // Stored doubled (exact: a1 >= ~7e-4, a3 >= ~1e-9, all normal).\n        _mm256_store_ps(A1 + i, _mm256_add_ps(a1, a1));\n        _mm256_store_ps(A2 + i, _mm256_add_ps(a2, a2));\n        _mm256_store_ps(A3 + i, _mm256_add_ps(a3, a3));\n    }\n    // Honour the scalar coefficient cache for a leading run of unchanged params.\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        if (!(F0[i] == state.last_freq && q[i] == state.last_q)) break;\n        G[i] = state.g; K[i] = state.k;\n        A1[i] = 2.0f * state.a1; A2[i] = 2.0f * state.a2; A3[i] = 2.0f * state.a3;\n    }\n    constexpr std::size_t L = BLOCK_SIZE - 1;\n    state.last_freq = F0[L];\n    state.last_q = q[L];\n    state.g = G[L]; state.k = K[L];\n    state.a1 = 0.5f * A1[L]; state.a2 = 0.5f * A2[L]; state.a3 = 0.5f * A3[L];\n\n    // Fast path, valid while every state lane has |s| in [2^-35, 10]: then\n    // s + DENORMAL_DC == s, and with doubled coefficients 2*v is formed\n    // directly (products stay >= 2^-90, so doubling commutes with rounding),\n    // leaving a 4-op chain. A result outside the range is recomputed exactly.\n    __m128 s1 = _mm_setr_ps(state.ic1eq[0], state.ic1eq[1], 0.0f, 0.0f);\n    __m128 s2 = _mm_setr_ps(state.ic2eq[0], state.ic2eq[1], 0.0f, 0.0f);\n    const __m128 half = _mm_set1_ps(0.5f);\n    bool fast = !svf_out_of_range(s1, s2);\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        const __m128 x = in_r ? _mm_unpacklo_ps(_mm_load_ss(in_l + i), _mm_load_ss(in_r + i))\n                              : _mm_set1_ps(in_l[i]);\n        const __m128 d1 = _mm_set1_ps(A1[i]);\n        const __m128 d2 = _mm_set1_ps(A2[i]);\n        const __m128 d3 = _mm_set1_ps(A3[i]);\n        const __m128 v3 = _mm_sub_ps(x, s2);\n        const __m128 w1 = _mm_add_ps(_mm_mul_ps(d1, s1), _mm_mul_ps(d2, v3));\n        const __m128 w2 = _mm_add_ps(_mm_add_ps(_mm_add_ps(s2, s2), _mm_mul_ps(d2, s1)),\n                                     _mm_mul_ps(d3, v3));\n        const __m128 n1 = _mm_sub_ps(w1, s1);\n        const __m128 n2 = _mm_sub_ps(w2, s2);\n        __m128 v1 = _mm_mul_ps(half, w1);\n        __m128 v2 = _mm_mul_ps(half, w2);\n        if (__builtin_expect(fast && !svf_out_of_range(n1, n2), 1)) {\n _mm_mul_ps(half, d1);\n            const __m128 a2 = _mm_mul_ps(half, d2);\n            const __m128 a3 = _mm_mul_ps(half, d3);\n            const __m128 t1 = _mm_add_ps(s1, dc);\n            const __m128 t2 = _mm_add_ps(s2, dc);\n            const __m128 e3 = _mm_sub_ps(x, t2);\n            v1 = _mm_add_ps(_mm_mul_ps(a1, t1), _mm_mul_ps(a2, e3));\n            v2 = _mm_add_ps(_mm_add_ps(t2, _mm_mul_ps(a2, t1)), _mm_mul_ps(a3, e3));\n            s1 = svf_clamp_ps(_mm_sub_ps(_mm_mul_ps(two, v1), s1));\n            s2 = svf_clamp_ps(_mm_sub_ps(_mm_mul_ps(two, v2), s2));\n            fast = !svf_out_of_range(s1, s2);\n        }\n        __m128 y;\n        if constexpr (Mode == 0) y = v2;\n        else if constexpr (Mode == 2) y = v1;\n        else y = _mm_sub_ps(_mm_sub_ps(x, _mm_mul_ps(_mm_set1_ps(K[i]), v1)), v2);\n        _mm_storel_pi(reinterpret_cast<__m64*>(Y + 2 * i), y);\n    }\n    alignas(16) float st1[4], st2[4];\n    _mm_store_ps(st1, s1);\n    _mm_store_ps(st2, s2);\n    state.ic1eq[0] = st1[0]; state.ic1eq[1] = st1[1];\n    state.ic2eq[0] = st2[0]; state.ic2eq[1] = st2[1];\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 4) {\n        const __m128 a = _mm_load_ps(Y + 2 * i);\n        const __m128 b = _mm_load_ps(Y + 2 * i + 4);\n        const __m128 yl = _mm_shuffle_ps(a, b, _MM_SHUFFLE(2, 0, 2, 0));\n        const __m128 yr = _mm_shuffle_ps(a, b, _MM_SHUFFLE(3, 1, 3, 1));\n        const __m128 xl = _mm_load_ps(in_l + i);\n        const __m128 xr = in_r ? _mm_load_ps(in_r + i) : xl;\n        const __m128 dry = dry_level ? _mm_load_ps(dry_level + i) : _mm_setzero_ps();\n        const __m128 wet = wet_level ? _mm_load_ps(wet_level + i) : _mm_set1_ps(1.0f);\n        _mm_store_ps(out_l + i, _mm_add_ps(_mm_mul_ps(xl, dry), _mm_mul_ps(yl, wet)));\n        _mm_store_ps(out_r + i, _mm_add_ps(_mm_mul_ps(xr, dry), _mm_mul_ps(yr, wet)));\n    }\n}\n#endif\n}  // namespace kernels\n\n// SVF Lowpass — stereo-native saturation function (fast tanh approximation)\n// Provides analog-like nonlinearity in the feedback path\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline float soft_clip(float x) {\n    // Pade approximant of tanh, ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.out_buffer + 1));\n    const float* input = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const bool stereo_in = (inst.flags & InstructionFlag::STEREO_INPUT) != 0;\n    const float* input_r = stereo_in\n        ? ctx.buffers->get(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(inst.inputs[0] + 1))\n        : nullptr;\n    const float* freq = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n state = ctx.states->get_or_create<MoogState>(inst.state_id);\n\n    // ExtendedParams<2>: ext[0] = dry (default 0.0), ext[1] = wet (default 1.0)\n    const auto* ext = ctx.states->get_if<ExtendedParams<2>>(ext_params_state_id(inst.state_id));\n    const float* dry_buf = nullptr; float dry_const = 0.0f;\n    const float* wet_buf = nullptr; float wet_const = 1.0f;\n input[i] : (stereo_in ? input_r[i] : input[i]);\n\n            // Get feedback with diode clipping (the MS-20 \"scream\") — per-channel state\n            float fb = state.cap2[ch] * state.k;\n            fb = diode_clip(fb, state.diode_state[ch], clip_threshold);\n\n            // Input with feedback\n            float x = xin - fb;\n\n            // First stage\n            float v1 = G * (x - state.cap1[ch]) + state.cap1[ch];\n\n            // Second stage with resonance boost\n            float v2 = G * (v1 - state.cap2[ch]) + state.cap2[ch];\n\n            // Update capacitor states\n            state.cap1[ch] = clamp_audio(2.0f * v1 - state.cap1[ch]);\n            state.cap2[ch] = clamp_audio(2.0f * v2 - state.cap2[ch]);\n\n            // Mode selection: 0 = lowpass, 1 = highpass\n            float lp = v2;\n            float hp = x - v1 * (1.0f + state.k * 0.5f) - v2;\n\n            // Crossfade between LP and HP based on mode\n            float processed = lp * (1.0f - m) + hp * m;\n            (ch == 0 ? out_l : out_r)[i] = drywet::mix(xin, processed, dry, wet);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n}  // namespace cedar\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":140,"oldLines":30,"newStart":140,"newLines":6,"lines":["     return _mm_movemask_ps(_mm_castsi128_ps(bad)) != 0;"," }"," ","-// One exact (scalar-order) integrator step with doubled coefficients d1..d3.","-// In: sv = {s1, s2, x, d1}. Returns whether the","-// new state admits the fast path.","-[[gnu::noinline, gnu::cold]] CEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 inline bool svf_exact_step(__m128* sv, __m128 d2,","-                                                                         __m128 d3) noexcept {","-    const __m128 half = _mm_set1_ps(0.5f);","-    const __m128 dc = _mm_set1_ps(DENORMAL_DC);","-    const __m128 two = _mm_set1_ps(2.0f);","-    const __m128 s1 = sv[0], s2 = sv[1], x = sv[2];","-    const __m128 a1 = _mm_mul_ps(half, sv[3]);","-    const __m128 a2 = _mm_mul_ps(half, d2);","-    const __m128 a3 = _mm_mul_ps(half, d3);","-    const __m128 t1 = _mm_add_ps(s1, dc);","-    const __m128 t2 = _mm_add_ps(s2, dc);","-    const __m128 v3 = _mm_sub_ps(x, t2);","-    const __m128 v1 = _mm_add_ps(_mm_mul_ps(a1, t1), _mm_mul_ps(a2, v3));","-    const __m128 v2 = _mm_add_ps(_mm_add_ps(t2, _mm_mul_ps(a2, t1)), _mm_mul_ps(a3, v3));","-    sv[0] = svf_clamp_ps(_mm_sub_ps(_mm_mul_ps(two, v1), s1));","-    sv[1] = svf_clamp_ps(_mm_sub_ps(_mm_mul_ps(two, v2), s2));","-    sv[2] = v1;","-    sv[3] = v2;","-    return !svf_out_of_range(sv[0], sv[1]);","-}","-"," // Mode: 0 = lowpass (v2), 1 = highpass, 2 = bandpass (v1)."," // Coefficients are a pure function of (freq, q), so they are computed for the"," // whole block first; only the integrator recurrence stays serial."]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true}}
